name: IPSC (P)(22.5×34.5)
short_description: Official USPSA/IPSC Practice Target
description:
IPSC(P) – Official USPSA/IPSC Practice Target

The IPSC(P) is the official paper practice target for International Practical Shooting Confederation (IPSC) and United States Practical Shooting Association (USPSA) training and competition. This sanctioned target replicates the standard cardboard “Classic” target design in a lightweight paper format, making it ideal for high-volume practice sessions focusing on speed, accuracy, and competitive shooting fundamentals.

Physical Specifications

Size: 22.5″ × 34.5″ – standard IPSC/USPSA dimensions ensuring full compatibility with match-style setups

Material: Lightweight paper construction for clean bullet hole definition and easy handling

Design Features: Clearly marked A, C, and D scoring zones corresponding to competition point values (5, 3, and 1 points respectively in minor scoring; 5, 4, and 2 points in major scoring)

Packaging & Pricing

Pack Size: 100 sheets per pack for economical bulk training

Material Benefits: Light paper stock provides crisp shot visibility while remaining cost-effective for extensive practice sessions

Use Cases

Competition Preparation: Official USPSA/IPSC design ensures practice sessions accurately mirror competitive scenarios and scoring standards

Cost-Effective Training: Significantly more economical than cardboard targets while maintaining official scoring zone accuracy for budget-conscious shooters

High-Volume Practice: Lightweight construction makes target changes quick and efficient during intensive training drills and classifier preparation

Enhanced Visibility: Clear scoring zone delineation allows for rapid shot assessment and immediate feedback during speed shooting exercises

Quick Specs Table

Feature Specification
Use USPSA/IPSC competition practice & training
Dimensions 22.5″ × 34.5″
Scoring Zones A, C, D (5-3-1 minor / 5-4-2 major points)
Material Lightweight paper
Pack Size 100 sheets
Price $48.40 per pack

name: IPSC (CB)(25)
short_description: Cardboard Official USPSA/IPSC Combat Target
description:
IPSC(CB) – Official USPSA/IPSC Cardboard Combat Target

The IPSC(CB) is the official cardboard target used in USPSA and IPSC competition matches, representing the premium standard for practical shooting sports. Constructed from durable cardboard with a brown front and white back design, this target provides the authentic competition experience that serious shooters demand for match preparation and official events.
